Sections Get ready to make deductions : Payroll Learn about Canada Pension Plan (CPP), Employment Insurance (EI) and the income tax deductions, including the CPP, EI and income tax rates, the CPP/EI maximums and the CPP exemptions Determine if a benefit is taxable : Payroll Before you calculate, determine if the benefits are taxable and if you need to deduct CPP, EI and income tax Determine the tax treatment of payments other than regular employment income : Payroll Before you calculate, determine if you need to deduct CPP, EI and income tax from payments other than regular employment income or in special situations (for example, when individual life situation changes or to find out when a worker is an employee or self-employed) How to calculate : Payroll Determine which method you can use to calculate deductions, get the CPP contributions tables, the EI premiums tables, the claim codes and the income tax tables to calculate manually the amount to withhold Make corrections before filing : Payroll What to do if you want to correct deductions errors in the current tax year Related information Payroll Deductions Online Calculator CPP and EI rulings Page details 2025-12-18 About this site Canada Revenue Agency (CRA) Contact the CRA Update your information About the CRA Government of Canada All contacts Departments and agencies About government Themes and topics Jobs Immigration and citizenship Travel and tourism Business Benefits Health Taxes Environment and natural resources National security and defence Culture, history and sport Policing, justice and emergencies Transport and infrastructure Canada and the world Money and finances Science and innovation Indigenous Peoples Veterans and military Youth Manage life events Government of Canada Corporate Social media Mobile applications About Canada.ca Terms and conditions Privacy
